events.title: Church in the Garden
events.description:
A relaxed gathering outside. ☀️

We will hear a story from the Bible, have a craft available, and enjoy time together, ending with a picnic tea.

events.title: The Big Church Clean
events.description:
Join us for our annual Big Church Clean! 🧹

As we prepare for another school year, let's come together to get everything ready.

events.title: Prayer Meeting
events.description:
Join us for our monthly prayer meetings to pray for Coopers Edge Community Church.

events.title: The Ark Toddler Group
events.description:
This group is run by Coopers Edge Community Church and our hope is this will be a place of sanctuary, fun and belonging for the families of Coopers Edge.

Our time together looks like:

9.30am Doors open

9.30-10.30am Free Play - help yourself to coffee!

10.30am Tidy Up Time

10.40am Song Time

10.50am Snack and Bible Story
